items.title: 3 Market-Beating Stocks to Keep an Eye On

items.title: How Berkshire’s New CEO Plans to Protect Iowa Power Costs From Hyperscaler Data Center Expansion
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway  CEO Greg Abel said the company will only provide power for new data centers if other utility customers benefit.  In a wide-ranging interview Wednesday morning with CNBC from Tokyo—where Abel is visiting with several large Japanese trading companies in which Berkshire has investments—the CEO discussed how Berkshire’s big utility, Berkshire Hathaway Energy, approaches data centers.
